subject: SIG initiation: security questionnaire triage & prefill asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG initiation: security questionnaire triage & prefill asks

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as we kick off your security review.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Use case: inference API for summarization + structured extraction from EHR exports.
- Residency: prefer US-only hosting (primary region us-east-1).
- Compliance posture: you mentioned active SOC 2 program (Type II expected later this year) and a signed BAA for PHI.
- Auth: SSO via Okta; SCIM yes/no TBD.
- Volume: modest production volume to start (~10–25 reqs/s peak).

Immediate asks to initiate SIG/CAIQ (we can prefill if helpful):
1) Which form do you prefer we start with — SIG, CAIQ, or a custom spreadsheet? (we can prefill CAIQ partially to speed things up)
2) Please confirm whether PHI will ever be included in free-text prompts, or only as structured EHR extracts.
3) Can you share a network diagram (VPC peering / firewall boundaries) and SSO metadata (IdP metadata XML)?
4) Any contractual timeline constraints (NDA/DocuSign before we share system diagrams)?

I attached a short prefill template (redwood-sig-prefill-v1.pdf) with the fields we usually complete on behalf of customers — if you prefer we start there, mark sections we should not auto-fill.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm form preference and NDA needs (you or security@medicore.com).
- If OK, we prefill CAIQ v2 and send for your review within 48 hours.
- Security engineer (Ben) will follow up on technical evidence required.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on the diagram/NDA so we can move the review forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Alex Morgan <alex@medicore.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medicore.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: security questionnaire triage & prefill asks

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 
- Form preference: CAIQ would be our first cut (we find it maps cleanly to our checklist). If Redwood strongly prefers SIG, we can do that instead.
- SOC 2: We're in the middle of a Type II run; expected completion Q4 2026 (no Type II report yet). We can share our Type I and supporting evidence currently.
- PHI: For now PHI will be limited to structured EHR extracts passed via secure pipelines; we do not intend to put raw PHI in free-text prompts. If that changes we'll flag it.
- Hosting/residency: us-east-1 is fine.
- SSO: Okta — we can provide IdP metadata once NDA is in place.

We can share a network diagram but legal prefers an NDA before sending diagrams to vendors. I'll request the NDA from procurement and loop security@medicore.com on signatures.

Ben — happy to coordinate if you have a short checklist of tech artifacts you need today (e.g., encryption at rest details, key management, sample logs).

I attached a high-level network PNG (redacted) for reference; full diagram after NDA.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Security Program Manager | MediCore Health
alex@medicore.com

Attachments: medicore-network-diagram.png (PNG stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@medicore.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: security questionnaire triage & prefill asks

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for the details, Alex. Quick tech clarifications and what would help speed evidence collection on our side: 

Short answers: 
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 for model weights and customer data; envelope encryption with AWS KMS by default.
- KMS options: we support Redwood-managed KMS keys or customer-managed (BYOK) via AWS KMS. HSM-backed keys (partner integration) available for enterprise customers — we can discuss if you need HSM.
- Logging/retention: request and access logs retained by default 90 days; we can configure longer retention for enterprise plans.

Requested artifacts to attach to CAIQ prefill: 
- Current SOC artifacts you can share (Type I / in-flight evidence).
- Full network diagram (post-NDA).
- Okta IdP metadata XML / SAML SSO endpoints.
- Example redacted logs demonstrating request/response headers (for audit sampling).

Operational ask: is PHI strictly contained to structured EHR extracts (as you noted)? we still need to know if any downstream transformations or enrichment will occur on free-text content.

I attached a short evidence checklist we use (evidence-checklist.xlsx) — if you can mark which items are available now we can prioritize the CAIQ sections to prefill. Once we have the minimal set, we can turn around a prefilled CAIQ within 48 hours for your review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min screen share to run through the prefill together.

Best,
Ben Carter
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Alex Morgan <alex@medicore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medicore.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: security questionnaire triage & prefill asks

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks, that all helps. Confirming the PHI note — PHI will be limited to structured EHR extracts we push through secure pipelines; we will not send free-text containing raw PHI initially. If we broaden usage later, we will notify.

We can provide the following after NDA: full VPC/network diagram, Okta IdP metadata (XML), and a redacted log sample. SOC Type I is available now; Type II expected Q4 and we'll share once finalized.

Procurement is preparing the NDA via DocuSign — I will drop the link once it’s ready (ETA tomorrow). In the meantime, please go ahead and prefill CAIQ where you can using the answers above; we’ll review and mark any discrepancies.

Would appreciate a 30-min next-step call to walk the prefilled CAIQ and confirm the evidence matrix — here’s a scheduling link: https://calendly.com/alex-medicore/30min (I included security@medicore.com on the thread).

Thanks,
Alex
Security Program Manager | MediCore Health
alex@medicore.com
